text:
Ibrahim Ali: Quick heads-up - BluePeak EBR is Friday 8am PT. They've surfaced onboarding gaps and one SLO slip last week. Need a tight runbook + slide that explains mitigation and next 30-day plan.

Noelle Ruiz: Copy. I'll own the onboarding status slide. I'll surface which playbooks were executed and outstanding tasks.

Cait Lin: I'll grab logs for the SLO incident and distill the root cause. Short ask: can Eng deliver the mini postmortem paragraph by Thu?

Omar Singh: Yep — I'll paste a 3-bullet summary and the perf patch we rolled. Also proposing we include a temporary rate-limit workaround we applied.

Hannah Park: Customer-facing note: BluePeak product manager asked for enablement sessions for their ML infra team next week. Can we propose two 60-min slots on Tue/Wed?

Ibrahim Ali: Yes schedule 2x slots. Also, for renewal-risk slide: BluePeak CFO has signaled price sensitivity. We should add a tailored uplift offer (12mo commit) + case study ROI. Noelle, can you add a short ROI line?

Noelle Ruiz: Will add ROI bullets. Need the latest usage delta and cost avoidance numbers from finance. Cait, can you confirm token/day peak for April?

Cait Lin: April peak tokens/day = 48M. Avg = 15M. Adding it to slide 3.

ebr-bot: Reminder: EBR prep checklist incomplete (slides 1-3). Deadline: 2025-05-09T18:00:00Z.

Omar Singh: Mini postmortem paragraph (for slide appendix):
```
- Incident: KV cache invalidation during config rollout caused transient 2.2x latency spike (2025-04-27 14:12 UTC)
- Root cause: staging flag diff, cached keys expired earlier under heavy load
- Mitigation: rolled back config, applied cache warmup, added guardrail tests
- Action: infra will add canary + alert for cache miss rate > 1%
```

Hannah Park: Regarding enablement, BluePeak prefers Wed 16:00 UTC and Thu 09:00 PT. I'll propose those in the invite and include a short agenda (how to onboard models, KV cache best practices, monitoring hooks).

Ibrahim Ali: Good. Action owners: Noelle (slides + ROI), Cait (SLO numbers + logs), Omar (postmortem paragraph + infra ask), Hannah (enablement invites), Ibrahim (exec talking points + renewal proposal). Dry run Thurs 11am PT.

Noelle Ruiz: Publishing a slim 1-pager for execs with 3 asks: 1) Approve 12mo discounted commit, 2) Fund enablement sessions, 3) Greenlight infra guardrail budget. Posting link in thread when ready.

Cait Lin: One more note - can we surface a customer quote about time-to-first-inference? BluePeak said: "Onboarding with Redwood cut our model rollout time by half." Should I include?

Ibrahim Ali: Yes include that as a slide callout.

ebr-bot: Dry run reminder scheduled: 2025-05-08T18:00:00Z. Make sure deck link is updated.

Omar Singh: I'll drop the RFC for the alert and tag eng-oncall. Expect the paragraph and patch link in the deck by Wed EOD.

Hannah Park: Invite sent to BluePeak PM + infra. Tentative acceptance for Wed.

Ibrahim Ali: Thanks team. Final note: keep slides lean (no more than 8). Execs want clear ask + risk mitigation.

Noelle Ruiz: Aiming to have slides in shared deck by Wed 9am PT. Will ping if anything missing. :white_check_mark:
